name: hvac-erp-app
description: Full-Stack HVAC ERP Enterprise Operations Web Application

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/copy-dist.js
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node dist/index.js
